svg.title: Grow the culture bottom-up
svg.desc: Left: a leader on a podium with a megaphone orders everyone to do it one way, and the team goes quiet. Right: under a banner asking what the purpose is, a leader recruits volunteers, gives one of them a chance to try an idea, and then uses a megaphone to celebrate what they did.
svg.text: Start from Purpose: why are we doing this?
Be a catalyst and an amplifier, not a commander.
